verdict.rationale: Sandbox0 documents pausing compute and resuming the same sandbox while preserving the whole writable root filesystem, including auto_resume on inbound access and no compute charges while paused. Memory preservation is only an experimental opt-in (`memory: true`) that covers 'supported process state', which is a significant caveat for the memory half of the story. Missing for 10: generally available (non-experimental) memory/process-state preservation, clarity on which process state is supported, independent or hands-on corroboration of pause/resume fidelity.
